notes.name: Victory Rush
notes.description: Baseline now - sits in the Arms tab of the level 38 demo spellbook.

notes.name: Tactical Mastery
notes.description: Now a baseline passive in Arms rather than a talent.

notes.name: Intercept
notes.description: Missing from the Fury tab where Classic trains it at 30 - possibly moved or cut, though the demo's level cap could just be hiding it.

notes.name: Slam
notes.description: Reaches Rank 3 by level 38, versus level 46 in Classic - ranks have been reshuffled.

notes.name: Bloodrage
notes.description: Confirmed baseline, sitting in Protection alongside Shield Wall, Taunt, and Sunder Armor.

notes.name: Judgement
notes.description: No longer consumes your Seal. 10 yd range, 10 sec cooldown. Judging Seal of Fury deals Holy damage and taunts for 4 sec.

notes.name: Seal of Fury
notes.description: The trainable tank seal, Rank 4 by level 38. Melee hits deal Holy damage and, with a shield equipped, build an absorb shield.

notes.name: Holy Strike
notes.description: Baseline Retribution strike, Rank 5 by level 38, on a 12 sec cooldown.

notes.name: Blessing of Kings & Consecration
notes.description: Both baseline now rather than talents. Consecration trains at level 20.

notes.name: Aimed Shot
notes.description: Baseline now (a Classic Marksmanship talent), Rank 3 by level 38.

notes.name: Call Owl
notes.description: Call Pet is renamed after your actual pet - the demo Hunter's was an owl.

notes.name: One-handed axes
notes.description: Rogues can now wield axes - Hack and Slash lists Axe/Sword as a weapon group, which Classic rogues couldn't equip at all.

notes.name: Shadow Word: Death
notes.description: An execute-style Shadow spell.

notes.name: Devouring Plague
notes.description: Now a normal Shadow spell rather than an Undead racial - Rank 3 by level 38, on a 1 min cooldown.

notes.name: Fear Ward
notes.description: Baseline for every Priest now, on a 3 min cooldown.

notes.name: Lightning Bolt
notes.description: Casts 0.5 sec faster at baseline - Rank 7 is a 2.5 sec cast versus 3 sec in Classic.

notes.name: Chain Lightning
notes.description: Also 0.5 sec faster at baseline - Rank 1 is a 2 sec cast versus 2.5 sec in Classic.

notes.name: Totemic Projection
notes.description: A new Enhancement ability in the demo spellbook, alongside Totemic Recall.

notes.name: Fire Nova
notes.description: Now cast directly rather than through Fire Nova Totem, with its own cooldown.

notes.name: Comprehend Scroll
notes.description: A new General-tab ability, seen on a Skyborne Mage in the demo.

notes.name: Frostfire Bolt
notes.description: A combined Fire/Frost bolt spell.

notes.name: Subjugate Demon
notes.description: Enslave Demon renamed, Rank 1 by level 38.

notes.name: Bane of Agony / Bane of Doom
notes.description: Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom, renamed.

notes.name: Incubus
notes.description: A male counterpart to the Succubus - a separate demon summon.

notes.name: Omen of Clarity & Nature's Grasp
notes.description: Both baseline now - these were Classic talents.

notes.name: Revive
notes.description: A new out-of-combat resurrection: 10 sec cast, brings a player back with 300 health and 520 mana at Rank 3. Rebirth keeps its own 30 min cooldown.

notes.name: Cure Poison
notes.description: Gone - Abolish Poison is the only poison cure in the demo spellbook.

bonuses.name: Mixology
bonuses.d: Elixirs and flasks last longer and provide stronger effects.

bonuses.name: Philosopher's Stone
bonuses.d: Craft an upgradable trinket that grows with your Alchemy skill.

bonuses.name: New Recipes
bonuses.d: Access Forever alchemy recipes beyond Classic.

bonuses.name: Repair All
bonuses.d: Repair all of your equipment at once.

bonuses.name: Belt Buckles
bonuses.d: Craft belt buckles that add socketed stats to waist armor.

bonuses.name: New Recipes
bonuses.d: Access Forever blacksmithing recipes beyond Classic.

bonuses.name: Ring Enchants
bonuses.d: Enchant rings with permanent combat bonuses.

bonuses.name: Shard Transmutes
bonuses.d: Transmute enchanting shards into higher grades.

bonuses.name: Stave Crafting... and More!
bonuses.d: Craft staves and additional Forever enchanting recipes.

bonuses.name: Powerful Profession
bonuses.d: Engineering remains one of the most powerful combat professions.

bonuses.name: But Wait... There's More!
bonuses.d: Additional gadgets, bombs, and trinkets beyond Classic.

bonuses.name: Goblin or Gnome?
bonuses.d: Specialize into Goblin or Gnomish Engineering for unique recipes.

bonuses.name: Natural Talent
bonuses.d: Resistance to all schools of magic increased.

bonuses.name: Lotus Affinity
bonuses.d: Improved chance to find rare lotus herbs.

bonuses.name: Brutal Pickings
bonuses.d: Gather more herbs from nodes while Herbalism is trained.

bonuses.name: Armor Kits
bonuses.d: Craft armor kits that improve leather and mail gear.

bonuses.name: Must Go Faster...
bonuses.d: Mounted speed increased while Leatherworking is trained.

bonuses.name: Dragons and Elements
bonuses.d: Craft dragonscale and elemental leather sets.

bonuses.name: Made of Metal
bonuses.d: All your hard work spent mining has made you exceptionally tough, increasing your total health by 5%.

bonuses.name: A Lode of Ore
bonuses.d: Gather additional ore from mineral nodes.

bonuses.name: Malicious Mining
bonuses.d: Mining nodes may yield rare or combat-oriented materials.

bonuses.name: Beasts of the Wild
bonuses.d: Damage to Beasts and Dragonkin increased by 5%.

bonuses.name: Rare Hides
bonuses.d: Improved chance to skin rare and specialty hides.

bonuses.name: A Classic Starter Profession
bonuses.d: Skinning remains an easy pairing with Leatherworking.

bonuses.name: Embroider Your Work
bonuses.d: Embroider cloth gear with profession-only bonuses.

bonuses.name: Cloth Scavenging
bonuses.d: Chance to find extra cloth from humanoid enemies.

bonuses.name: New and Reworked Recipes
bonuses.d: Forever cloth sets and recipes beyond Classic.

shared.notes_source: Class notes are summarized from BlizzCon 2026 demo footage - each class's new abilities were read from a single reference character's trainer spellbook, capped at level 38 in the demo. Not Blizzard-confirmed, and subject to change once the beta opens.
